tools.name: preflight_transaction
tools.description: Before execution: assess one unsigned Base candidate. Free, no wallet/payment. CAUTION commonly means total cost is incomplete; simulation is not authorization or guaranteed success.

tools.name: verify_transaction
tools.description: After broadcast: verify observed Base transaction against explicit expectations. Default checks inclusion, NOT receipt success. VERIFIED is not finality, ownership or causality. Free; not-found/provider uncertainty is not success.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "preflight_transaction" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
